description.p: A simple GTK4 application to track shipments. It automatically refreshes tracking status and provides a clean overview of your deliveries.
Note: Currently, the app only supports DHL Germany. Support for additional carriers will be added in future updates.
Fixes the browser fallback used when the tracking API fails.

ul.li: No longer tries to drive a sandboxed browser, which could hang and leave stray processes behind

ul.li: Hermes tracking is disabled until it can be verified against a live shipment
Reports a clear error instead of crashing when no browser is available

description.p: Postcode lookup for DHL, more shipment detail, and a Wayland fix.

ul.li: Enter the recipient postcode to unlock details DHL withholds
Shows delivery window, progress and short status
Fixes a modal detail window that could block input on Wayland
